scope: All strictly cost-reducing one-for-one exchanges from fixed saved bases; no sequential adoption
predictor: Original Euclidean 5NN, saved three folds, fitting-only minmax
feasibility: Same full-set internal Brier reference, exact <=, prediction tolerance 0
ordering: Descending cost saving, then removed attribute index, then added index; independent of labels and candidate loss
matched_budget: Per dataset minimum candidate count across two bases; prefix comparisons; report exhaustion separately
choice: Feasible minimum cost, then loss, then indices; diagnostic best only
limitations: Development reused; no independent generalization, no global optimality; Yeast empty has no exchange
